How can we help?

Browse the categories or search directly to find answers about our services, process, pricing and technology.

OneClicq provides end-to-end technology services including Custom Software Development, Web Application Development, Mobile App Development, AI & Machine Learning Solutions, Cloud Migration, API Development & Integration, E-commerce Solutions, Payment Gateway Integration, and Software Maintenance & Support.
Yes. We design and develop custom software around your business processes, users and long-term goals. Solutions can be built from the ground up or integrated with your existing systems.
Yes. OneClicq develops responsive web applications, enterprise portals, SaaS platforms and mobile applications designed for modern users and business requirements.
Yes. We can integrate AI and machine learning capabilities into products and business workflows, including intelligent automation, AI-powered applications, predictive solutions and modern generative AI experiences.
Yes. Our Cloud Migration service covers planning, architecture, application migration, modernization and post-migration support. We can help businesses move existing workloads toward a more scalable cloud setup.
Yes. We develop and integrate APIs to connect applications, third-party services, internal platforms and external systems. The integration approach depends on your existing architecture, security requirements and business workflow.
Yes. We can build e-commerce experiences around your products, customers, business workflows and integrations. Solutions can include product management, customer experiences, order workflows and third-party integrations.
Yes. Payment Gateway Integration is one of our services. We can connect supported payment providers with your application or e-commerce platform while considering transaction flows, security and business requirements.
We start by understanding your business, goals, users, technical requirements and expected outcomes. From there, we can define the appropriate solution direction, scope and development approach.
Yes. We can work alongside internal teams or other technology partners depending on the project requirements. This can be useful for development, integrations, modernization or specialized technology work.
Project cost depends on scope, complexity, integrations, technology requirements, timeline and ongoing support. After understanding your requirements, we can recommend the appropriate project approach.
Engagement can be shaped around the project and business requirements. We can discuss the scope, priorities, timeline and delivery expectations before defining the most suitable approach.
Yes. Software Maintenance & Support is one of OneClicq's core services. Support can help keep applications stable, updated and aligned with changing business and technology requirements.
Yes. Existing applications can be reviewed and improved based on performance, usability, maintainability, integrations, architecture and future business needs.
You can use the Contact page to tell us about your project, requirements and goals. Our team can then review the information and discuss the appropriate next steps.
